axes.concept: A continuous plan document with a spatial price index: compare the four monthly prices while reading every cumulative tool list.
axes.layout: One shared rounded paper, a sticky 264px plan index at left and ruled tool sections at right; one column below 761px, with all four price rows before the tool document.
axes.navigation: Four real in-page anchors in catalogue order; an active location follows scroll, anchors focus the corresponding heading, and return links restore the originating entry focus. Existing login and account disclosure each gain one Plans link.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans and Geist Mono only; 24px page title, 20px section names, 24px desktop / 20px phone prices, 14px tools, 12px availability and cumulative labels.
axes.density: A calm index of 100px desktop rows / 72px phone rows beside compact two-column tools at 1101px and above; single-column tools at narrower widths. No feature carousel or collapsed benefits.
axes.components: Installed shadcn Button, Input and Skeleton; native account details and language select retained; custom anchor index and ruled sections recompose the sibling role-list/editor vocabulary.
axes.colour: Unchanged Pictures light/dark tokens. Neutral secondary fill locates the reading position; source accent appears on links and focus. Availability remains explicit muted text with a distinct outline icon.
axes.motion: Expressive spatial springs move the index marker between anchors, settle the document from -8px and sections from 26px with 63ms offsets; rules extend from 80% width over 500ms. Hover arrows move 4px over 180ms; reduced motion and still mode keep every destination and final layout without travel.
